metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session State (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: RTT • Regime • Measures • Paradox • Consent • Lineage
metadata.description: Defines the authoritative session state for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Session state is authoritative; all projections must conform to it.

authoritative_rules: dashboard, overlay, and UI files are projections only.
Projections MUST NOT contradict session state.
rtt_rules: rtt_node MUST be one of RTT1–RTT12.
RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
regime_rules: Regime MUST be one of: nominal, harmonic, resolution.
Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.
measure_rules: All measures MUST be numeric in [0,1].
Every threshold MUST cite a measure ID.
paradox_rules: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry.
consent_rules: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.
lineage_rules: Continuity (measure.c3) MUST NOT decrease across transitions.
substrate_rules: substrate_class MUST be one of: agentic, parametric, symbolic, edge.

non_claims: Session state does not revise RTT v0.9.
Session state does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Session state does not replace the human FFT book.
